metadata.title: Chiral Perturbation Theory: Introduction and Recent Results in the One-Nucleon Sector
title_lines: Chiral Perturbation Theory: Introduction and Recent Results
metadata.abstract: We provide an introduction to the basic concepts of chiral perturbation theory and discuss some recent developments in the manifestly Lorentz-invariant formulation of the one-nucleon sector.
